response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratio, AVG(line_count) AS avg_line_count FROM (SELECT order_item_id, AVG(product_price * 1.0 / derived_total_cost) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY order_item_id) t;

assumptions.assumption: Ratio is product_price / derived_total_cost per line item; rows where either is NULL yield NULL and are skipped by AVG. Multiplying by 1.0 forces non-integer division.
A derived_total_cost of 0 would cause a division error or NULL depending on the DBMS (SQLite returns NULL, which is skipped); no special handling is added.
The line-item count per order item counts all its invoice line item rows, including those with missing ratios.
